caption_fb:
The oldest person in your family remembers things no record will tell you.

If you saw them this week, call again before the stories fade. Some tips from the Beginning guide:
🔹 Record the call on your phone (ask first)
🔹 Have old photos or papers nearby. They bring memories back.
🔹 When they say a place name, ask them to say it twice, and write it the way it sounds
🔹 Don't fix the stories. Side stories often hold the village.

One phone call can be your first real clue.

Save this and make the call 📞
